clinical_success.label: Prespecified clinical efficacy objective met in qualified scope
clinical_success.requires: Protocol/SAP endpoint, decision/multiplicity rule, analysis population, public eligible result

training_policy.default: Deterministic identical historical feature derivations; every input lineage pre-origin

stages.name: Freeze scientific questions and qualification contracts
acceptance_checks: Versioned separate endpoints preserve original H1-H6
Reference, outcome and chronology contract regressions pass
Review assumptions and provenance are explicit

stages.name: Build agent-adjudicated T6 reference and fresh pilot
acceptance_checks: Existing 20 claims have source/version crosswalk
Ten fresh cases frozen before arm outputs
Two separated blinded agent assessments per required unit plus adjudication
All answers evaluator-only and procedural/shared-model limits explicit

stages.name: Qualify historical clinical inputs and origin scope
acceptance_checks: Historical OT24.09 complete lineage is qualified, with no current fallback
Origin cohort and scope sealed before endpoint joins
Supplied Jan2026 AACT restored/audited only on evaluator side
Reporting-lag evidence qualified or missing file explicitly identified

stages.name: Adjudicate outcomes and assess power/precision
acceptance_checks: Event and no-recorded samples adjudicated for each named endpoint
Unknown/censored/competing states never automatic negatives
Qualified counts and measured dependence feed frozen simulations
80% power for 0.05 AUROC is planning target; calibration precision separate

stages.name: Qualify conditional genetics branch
acceptance_checks: Method-specific input contracts qualified
Source discrepancy disposition retained
Assay and biological scope preserved
Independent computations and weak/conflicting-signal fixtures pass, or branch explicitly deferred

stages.name: Train and calibrate qualified scorer
acceptance_checks: Every feature ancestor and model qualifies at its row origin
Training and calibration outcomes available before test origin
Grouped splits and train-only preprocessing sealed
Qualified scoring data/power support fitting; otherwise retained no-fit decision
deliverables: Frozen scorer or explicit no-fit report

stages.name: Activate supported matched comparisons
acceptance_checks: Adapted comparator evidence/model/budget/containment passes
Actual workflow ablations distinguished from masks
T6 source-reference agreement labeled agent-adjudicated if applicable
Clinical activation conditional on qualified chronology/outcomes/scorer/power
Predictions sealed before evaluator label join

conditional_routes.genetics: Not required for T6 or a qualified non-genetic scorer
conditional_routes.clinical_evaluation: Unavailable/withheld until its independent eligibility, label, scoring and power requirements pass
conditional_routes.agent_panel: Allowed for source-grounded development comparisons; not externally validated truth

boundaries: No paid provider calls, account registration or external outreach
No public preregistration submission without user authorization
Existing downloader, original receipts and stopped monitor untouched
No later annotation or evaluation-only ancestor admitted as historical feature
